title: IPLookUp
description: IPLookup is a lightweight and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin that allows players to view their own IP address directly in-game using a single command.
body:
IPLookup is a lightweight and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin that allows players to view their own IP address directly in-game using a single command.

Perfect for support situations, testing setups, or server environments where players need quick access to their connection information.

✨ Features

✅ View your own IP address in-game
✅ Fully customizable messages
✅ Configurable prefix and formatting
✅ Optional IP masking (for privacy)
✅ Lightweight and performance-friendly
✅ Easy configuration file
✅ Reload support via config changes

📜 Command
/iplookup

Displays the player’s current IP address.
